# mimecast_threat_reporting_subscription (Resource)

Manage a Mimecast threat-reporting webhook subscription. Client state values are write-only and never stored.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "threat_reporting_client_state" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "mimecast_threat_reporting_subscription" "example" {
  notification_url        = "https://webhook.example.com/mimecast"
  resource_type           = "threat-analysis"
  client_state_wo         = var.threat_reporting_client_state
  client_state_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `client_state_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Client state used to verify webhook notifications. Write-only and required when creating or renewing.
- `client_state_wo_version` (Number) Version trigger for client_state_wo. Increment to renew or rotate the subscription.
- `notification_url` (String) Public HTTPS callback URL. The subscription API cannot update this value, so changes replace the resource.
- `old_client_state_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Previous client state required when rotating client_state_wo. If omitted during renewal, client_state_wo is reused as the old value.
- `resource_type` (String) Subscribed resource type. Mimecast currently supports only threat-analysis.

### Read-Only

- `creation_date_time` (String) Subscription creation time returned by Mimecast.
- `expiration_date_time` (String) Subscription expiration time returned by Mimecast.
- `id` (String) Mimecast subscription ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_threat_reporting_subscription.example subscription-id
```
